name: GovCIO
desc:
Associate Service Desk Technician - Tier I | $45,000 - $47,500/yr (roughly $21.63 - $22.84/hr estimate) | Inbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: GovCIO
Industry: Government IT Services / Veterans Affairs Support
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be the first point of contact when a Veteran or VA provider is having a tech issue, things like setting up a mobile device, troubleshooting a login, or fixing basic hardware or software problems across phones, tablets, and computers. You'd walk people through fixes step by step over the phone or chat, documenting everything carefully in a ticketing system as you go. A lot of this role is about patience and reassurance since you're often helping someone who isn't very tech savvy, so being calm and clear matters just as much as knowing the technical fix. It's meaningful work supporting the people who served, with real growth potential into more specialized support queues over time.
assessment: Expect a basic assessment, a typing test, and a home internet speed test, since the posting doesn't state otherwise. This role also requires obtaining a Public Trust Security Clearance, which involves a background check and biometric ID verification.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: High school diploma required. Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred
Required Experience: Minimum 1 year of technical support, help desk, or call center experience, or a relevant degree/certification in lieu of experience
Preferred Experience: Certifications like CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, ACSP, or Google IT Support. Experience with Cisco videoconferencing systems, medical terminology, or healthcare IT support. Prior military service or experience supporting the military/veteran community
Required Skills:
Strong working knowledge of Android/iOS devices, tablets, Windows/Mac PCs, and video conferencing platforms
Familiarity with service desk ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow
Excellent verbal and written customer service communication
Ability to handle confidential information (PHI/PII) with discretion
Demonstrated reliability, punctuality, and consistent attendance
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with at least a year of help desk, technical support, or call center experience who enjoys walking people through tech problems patiently
Someone comfortable obtaining a Public Trust Security Clearance and U.S. citizenship, both required
A great fit for a participant with military connection or interest in supporting Veterans specifically
Someone who wants a genuine technical career track with real certification support built in
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone who is not a U.S. citizen, this is a hard requirement due to the clearance
Anyone who cannot pass a background check covering the past 7 years of criminal and employment history
Anyone without at least a year of technical support or call center experience
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Technical support
Help desk
ServiceNow ticketing
Mobile device support (iOS/Android)
Customer service
Public Trust Clearance
IT troubleshooting
Veterans Affairs support
First Call Resolution (FCR)
Confidential information handling (PHI/PII)
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview, conducted via video with camera on and photo ID required
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average. Note this role also requires enhanced biometric ID verification and a background check covering the past 7 years before starting.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your experience in a help desk, technical support, or call center role.
Walk us through how you'd guide a non-technical user through setting up a mobile device over the phone.
How do you stay calm and reassuring when a caller is frustrated or confused during troubleshooting?
What's your experience with ticketing systems like ServiceNow?
Are you comfortable obtaining and maintaining a Public Trust Security Clearance, including a background check and biometric verification?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $45,000 to $47,500 annually, roughly $21.63 to $22.84 per hour as an estimate
Shift: Monday through Friday, 10:30 AM to 7:00 PM Eastern Time (converted to 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM CST)
Benefits: Employee Assistance Program, corporate discounts, learning and development platform with certification prep content, training and education assistance, referral bonus program, internal mobility program, pet insurance, and a flexible work environment
Equipment Provided: Not specified in the posting, and no internet requirement is listed either. Confirm both during the recruiter screen
Felony Friendly?: Not explicitly stated as felony friendly. A background check covering the past 7 years of criminal history is required due to the Public Trust Clearance requirement
Drug Test: Not stated
Notes: This is a meaningful opportunity for a participant who wants to build real IT support skills while directly helping Veterans, with genuine certification support and career growth built into the role. The Public Trust Clearance requirement is a real gate to flag upfront, since it requires U.S. citizenship and a clean-enough background over the past 7 years. This one is worth highlighting for participants with a military connection or a strong interest in tech support careers.
Career Pathway: Associate Service Desk Technician, Tier I → Service Desk Technician, Tier II → Senior IT Support Specialist or Team Lead
training: 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM CST M- F
